meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this NEW Home:* 1 Mile to Grayton Dunes Beach Access* 4 Bikes Available* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* 100ft to Resort style, zero-entry pool w/ clubhouse* Walk to Hurricane Oyster Bar and Grayton Corne
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this NEW Home:* 1 Mile to Grayton Dunes Beach Access* 4 Bikes Available* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* 100ft to Resort style, zero-entry pool w/ clubhouse* Walk to Hurricane Oyster Bar and Grayton Corner Café* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Grayton 91 is a beautiful 4 bedroom, 3 bath home with spacious common areas, complete with a gourmet kitchen featuring quartz countertops and stainless-steel appliances. This home boasts vaulted ceilings and an open style floor plan perfect for entertaining! Enjoy games around the table or relax on the porch space! With two king master bedrooms, a bedroom with two twin-over-twin bunk beds, and a bonus room with a twin daybed and twin trundle, this home can sleep up to 10 guests comfortably! Chill on the shaded porch and balcony or head on down to the community pool just steps away. You will also find a Blackstone grill outside for your pleasure. Take the bikes to enjoy the beautiful beaches of 30A and make wonderful vacation memories at Grayton 91, your joy is waiting!The Village at Grayton Beach is a new community of 47 coastal beach cottages accented with upscale touches, just minutes from the iconic white sand beaches of 30A. The Village is nearby Western Lake and Grayton State Park, perfect for launching paddle boards! The neighborhood features a resort style, zero-entry pool with a sun deck and pool house. Within walking distance to several local bars and eateries, this community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle. Come experience The Village at Grayton Beach and see why you’ll be returning year after year! The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom #1 (1st Floor): King BedMaster Bedroom #2 (2nd Floor): King Bed Guest Bedroom (2nd Floor): 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4)Bonus room (2nd Floor): Twin daybed with twin trundle (Sleeps 2)Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, it provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here!Grayton Beach is a funky, free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. Among the curving live oaks you'll find this unique beach town dotted with with coastal dune lakes and bounded by Point Washington State Forest and Grayton State Beach Park. Explore clever artwork from local artisans and several local dining options. There is a laid back vibe here that may be explained by one of the local bumper stickers that says,"Grayton Beach: Nice Dogs, Strange People". Unusual and eclectic, this is a beach town you will not want to miss.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
